messages:
Ravi (sec): alert from on-prem monitor: unexpected TLS session to external host from payments pod. source: namespace=payments pod=srv-pay-5 node=edge-node-3. Suspicious: used service account tokens in request header. Can someone triage network/evidence?

Noor (ops): I'm taking node access. placing host in maintenance and pulling captures. Which external endpoint?

Ravi (sec): dst: telemetry-bench.example.org:443. Seen at 2026-04-22T14:22:03Z. Looks like automated batch hitting an external collector.

Jin (oncall): Applying emergency egress block for namespace via NetworkPolicy and at VPC border as extra belt. Quick NetPol:```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: emergency-deny-egress-2026
  namespace: payments
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []``` Pushed to cluster.

Cam (platform): Good. Also escalate to customer contact and legal/compliance; for private deploys we have contractual notification steps. I can draft the email.

Noor (ops): Collecting evidence: tcpdump on host, sysdig capture, and kube-apiserver audit. Saving to /mnt/forensics/acme-staging-20260422.tar.gz and uploading to customer S3.

Ravi (sec): Revoke SA tokens for payments-processor now and create new ephemeral rotation plan. Command: `kubectl -n payments delete secret -l kubernetes.io/service-account.name=payments-processor` then restart pods.

Jin (oncall): Before restart, let's ensure keystore shim will be able to fetch new key versions. If we rotate KMS key, set shim to fail-closed so pods won't run without decrypt access. Cam: can we script a canary hostpool that routes traffic to pods using a read-only stub keystore?

Cam (platform): Yes. Plan: spawn canary hostpool with keystore stub (returns cached plaintext for safety) to drain non-critical traffic, then perform key rotation. We'll shorten cert TTLs and rotate certs to limit replay window.

Noor (ops): Running key rotation: `kcli kms rotate --key projects/acme/.../priv-deploy --wait`. After rotation we update keystore-shim config: `KMS_KEY_VERSION=v2` in /etc/keystore/config and `systemctl restart keystore-shim`. I'll automate with patch script.

Ravi (sec): Also lock down RBAC: remove permissions for SA to create secrets/configmaps while we investigate. Example RoleBinding deletion: `kubectl -n payments delete rolebinding payments-processor-binding`. Then create a restrictive Role and rebind minimal verbs.

Jin (oncall): Forensics jq query I ran against api-server audit log: `jq -r '.items[] | select(.user.username=="system:serviceaccount:payments:payments-processor") | {verb: .verb,resource: .objectRef.resource,ip: .requestReceivedTimestamp}'` shows 9 create/configmap events and 2 secret update events around 14:15-14:20.

Cam (platform): We should also add host-level eBPF hooks to block unexpected outbound DNS and TLS destinations for the customer's VPC. For private deployments we can push an eBPF policy via host-policy-agent: `host-policy apply --policy deny-dns-external`

Noor (ops): Noted. I'm also verifying container image digests and running `grype` for local vuln scan on suspect images. If images are pristine, likely creds misuse.

Ravi (sec): sec-bot created INC-2026-04-22-08 (sev3) and notified infra pager. Logged steps for SRE/forensics.

Cam (platform): Post-incident actions: add runbook entry to priv-deploy-runbooks: include NetPol templates, RBAC rollback snippets, KMS rotation commands, keystore-shim fail-open vs fail-closed guidance, legal notification template, and how to collect apiserver audit with requestDetails.sourceIPs. I'll open PR after we finish cleanup.

Jin (oncall): Keeping thread alive until evidence uploaded and rotations complete. Will post upload link and timeline when done.

Noor (ops): Evidence uploaded: s3://acme-forensics/staging-2026-04-22.tar.gz. Key rotation done at 02:00 UTC window (v2 active). Recreated SA tokens with limited TTL. Restarted pods on canary hostpool then rolled to rest.

Ravi (sec): Thanks team. Lina, please draft the compliance notification and add the short-term mitigations to the private-deploy SLA checklist (egress allowlist at VPC, short cert TTLs, RBAC least-privilege enforcement).

Cam (platform): Will do. PR draft link: https://git.internal/infra/runbooks/pull/482.

(End thread)
note: Incident coordination about on-prem private deployment egress, RBAC restriction, KMS key rotation, evidence collection and runbook updates.
